sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 200. Success value 100. 4x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 6 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 40% damage reflection for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Encouragement (continuous buff that renews the effect "fills the Unison gauge by 5" every 10 seconds) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 25 Cost.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 40% for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 11000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 11000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Only [Fake Demon King] Avos Dilhevia can be used as Unlocking Potential material
